settings.intro: Customized blazers and ethnic wear, designed with you and crafted by hand.

settings.title: Made for you, by hand
settings.text: For over three decades, our master tailors have been cutting, stitching and finishing garments by hand. Every customized blazer and ethnic outfit we make carries that experience — the right fabric, a precise fit and details you choose yourself.

settings.title: Reach out
settings.text: Message us on the website, Instagram, WhatsApp or email with what you have in mind — an occasion, a reference photo, or just an idea.

settings.title: Choose fabric & style
settings.text: We'll walk you through fabrics, cuts, linings, buttons and finishing details, and help you design a piece that's entirely yours.

settings.title: Measurements
settings.text: Our team takes your measurements — at our Bengaluru studio, or guided over a call.

settings.title: Fittings & delivery
settings.text: We craft your piece, fine-tune it at a fitting, and deliver it ready to wear. Customized orders include one free alteration.
